facts.fact: GabonReview reports that the ten-day preparatory workshop for the national civil registration conferences (assises nationales de l'état civil) closed on 8 October 2026, its final report going to the Interior minister to set the conferences' calendar; the reform strategy includes creating a national civil registration centre to centralise and secure the data.

GabonReview states the civil registration reform, including the planned national civil registration centre, is carried under component 2 of the Gabon Digital programme, financed by the World Bank; no domestic budget line is mentioned.

systems.owner: Gabon Digital programme, component 2; report to the Ministry of the Interior, Security and Decentralisation
systems.tiers: planned; to centralise and secure demographic data nationally
planned; to cover the whole territory

systems.system: Numéro d'identification personnel (NIP) / Carte nationale d'identité

note: The workshop's diagnosis (badly kept archives, irregular data-entry practices in some services, 1972 Civil Code) does not say how local offices make the record, so no events, made or offices fact.
